title: 2 Hour Private Sunset Boat Charter With Captain
blurb:
Enjoy a sunset tour of Lake Tahoe! Located on the beautiful shores of South Lake Tahoe, Boat Tahoe provides the ultimate boating experience on Lake Tahoe! With our private captained boat tours choose from a day of cruising the lake while visiting Emerald Bay, Vikingsholm, Fannette Island, D.L. Bliss State Park, Rubicon Bay, Meeks Bay, Sugar Pine Point State Park and more or enjoying a more action packed day of tubing, wakeboarding or water skiing. Our US Coast Guard licensed captains can cater your tour to your exact needs! Book your adventure today and enjoy an amazing day on Lake Tahoe!

* Groups over 6 passengers please make sure to read additional info below in the listing. All passengers (including children) count towards max capacity of booking.
